content: पर्युपास् €2 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To attend upon, worship, attend respectfully; पर्युपास्यन्त लक्ष्म्या <ls>R. 10. 62</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 38</ls>; <ls>Ms. 7. 37</ls>. .²2 To go to (for protection), resort to, seek shelter or patronage with; अशक्ता एव सर्वत्र नरेन्द्रं पर्युपासते <ls>Pt. 1. 241</ls>. .²3 To enclose, surround. .²4 To share in, partake of. .²5 To sit on. .²6 To live round.
